STS2BALANCEMOD-DEATH_REAP.title: Death Reap
STS2BALANCEMOD-DEATH_REAP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Heal HP equal to [gold]unblocked damage[/gold].
STS2BALANCEMOD-POWER_THOUGHT.title: Power Through
STS2BALANCEMOD-CONCENTRATE.title: Concentrate
STS2BALANCEMOD-ELECTRODYNAMICS.title: Electrodynamics
STS2BALANCEMOD-JAX.title: J.A.X.
STS2BALANCEMOD-NECRONOMICURSE.title: Necronomicurse
STS2BALANCEMOD-NECRONOMICURSE.descriptio: There is no escape from this [red]Curse[/red].
STS2BALANCEMOD-STEP_BY_STEP.title: Step by Step
STS2BALANCEMOD-STEP_BY_STEP.description: Spend {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} Energy. For the next {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} turns, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card and gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of your turn.
STS2BALANCEMOD-SPARRING.title: Sparring
STS2BALANCEMOD-SPARRING.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. The side that deals less damage heals {Heal:diff()} HP.
STS2BALANCEMOD-RAM.title: Ram
STS2BALANCEMOD-RAM.description: If [gold]Osty[/gold] has at least {HpLoss:diff()} HP, make it lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP and deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies.
DRAIN_POWER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Upgrade {IfUpgraded:show:all|{Cards:diff()} random} cards in your discard pile.
STS2BALANCEMOD-EVOLVE.title: Evolve
STS2BALANCEMOD-EVOLVE.description: Whenever you draw a Status card, draw {EvolvePower:diff()} {EvolvePower:plural:card|cards}.
PILLAR_OF_CREATION.description: Whenever you generate a card, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
GRAND_FINALE.description: Can only be played if the number of cards in your draw pile is less than or equal to X. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies.
WELL_LAID_PLANS.description: At the end of your turn, [gold]Retain[/gold] up to {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
STS2BALANCEMOD-EVISCERATE.title: Eviscerate
STS2BALANCEMOD-EVISCERATE.description:
Costs 1 less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each card discarded this turn.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage 3 times.
